newsitem.title: PERU: Man-hours lost in Peru strikes up 180 pct in Aug.
newsitem.headline: Man-hours lost in Peru strikes up 180 pct in Aug.

text.p: Peru lost 108,720 man-hours in five private sector strikes during August, up 180 percent from the 38,800 man-hours lost during two strikes in the same month last year, the Labor Ministry said Wednesday.

In the first eight months, Peru lost 797,800 man-hours in 60 private sector strikes, 6.6 percent less than the 854,000 hours lost in 78 strikes during the same period last year, the ministry said in its monthly report.
Peru lost a total 1.049 million man-hours through strikes in 1995, down from 1.937 million in 1994.
The figure has fallen dramatically from the total 15.068 million man-hours lost in 1990 when President Alberto Fujimori's government took power.
